units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:6">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא חד סיעא ח׳</he> a second caravan came.—Pl. <he>חוֹרְיֵי</he>.
Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵃ bot. אית לך ח׳ there are other cases for you to quote.—Fem. חוֹרִי, חוֹרַיְתָא, חוֹרַיְי׳ (noun) something else.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33">Lev. R. s. 33</cite> <he>אמר ח׳</he> gave another explanation.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:5:2">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ח׳ היא</he> it is another sore (not the one seen before). Ib. II, 81ᵇ top <he>בשתא ח׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>חוריתאי</he>) in the year following.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:1:3">Y. Succ. V, beg. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>בשובתא ח׳</he> the next Sabbath; a. e.
